source.implements: Phase checklist: the army and detachment rules, options and abilities of the list ckListed / ckOptListed lists (unless a unit of the list has the option as an ability: listed as theirs; the same ability on several units one line, a copy the list cannot use apart, marked); a rule or ability listed only through options with moments of their own is listed once, as itself, without them, at each end moment they name (Code Chivalric: End of your turn, of your opponent's, of the battle round); by data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js): To do now in each phase and turn its text says it is triggered (07.02: the phases; either turn: both), or under the moment it opens with (Start of the (first) battle round) or a sentence at the end of the battle round (ae), sections in the order of the game (End of your turn, End of your opponent's turn, then End of the battle round, after Fight · Their turn); Active now where its effect is used and it is not triggered; once-per-battle uses (perBattle; Kindred Sorcery's options each) under Once per battle, from where they are triggered (an option from where its rule is), with the Overview's boxes, and nothing of what they put in force; for the others, what they put in force from a rule of the list (f: "Riled up (X) · Waaagh!") and the ability they select (pickOptions: Active now where it is used, its own use or, made only of options, theirs when every one is read, within pk; none read: When unclear; not one listed itself, rolled, or whose own trigger is a unit activation, a); each line names its unit or source and opens the full text; a rule another rule of the list gives to units by keyword (g) says which and to whom; the battle rounds a rule's words name, quoted on its line ("(first, third and fifth battle rounds)", Harbingers of Dread); entries made of a named roll placed where the list makes it (ckRolled); inert rules and abilities the list cannot use are listed, marked; listed ones the table cannot place under When unclear, those with no phase under No phase; no stratagems; each section a fold (closed until opened, kept for the session), its line counting each part; a box per line per section, kept per list; Reset clears them (with Undo), not the once-per-battle ones

judgement.code: const ckListed = (e, once) => !!(e.s || e.stored || e.rolled || once);

source.implements: which rules, abilities and options the Phase checklist lists (ckListed, ckOptListed): an entry derive marks s (seqTrigger), one data.js gives a moment that derive cannot place (ckStored), or a once-per-battle use (perBattle); an option when its own words are s, or its rule is listed and its own WHEN line is not a unit activation (a)

an option of a rule or ability on the Phase checklist: its own trigger (and where it is used); with none, where its effect is used (via: its rule's trigger, where a once-per-battle one is chosen); with neither (or nothing read of it at all: a Dread ability), Active now for the whole duration its rule's own words give its options (oc, or pk for an ability's section: Might of Khorne "until the end of the battle", Shroudpsalm "until the start of your next Command phase", Aegis Protocol "until it enters a different one"); no duration read: When unclear (x, with via), not guessed

data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js --write), the Phase checklist table: per rule and ability, from its own words (withoutOptions): s listed (seqTrigger: a sentence naming the start or end of a battle round, turn or phase, a Command phase, or another phase with a choice, with no unit activation: selected to…, each time / when this or a unit or model…, this unit's move or attacks, makes an attack / charge / move, is targeted, targets this, destroys, is destroyed, the first time); t the phases its text names (table 1's trigger) less those only its opening moment gives and those named only as "your / the next X phase" beside another trigger (Umbralefic Crystal's ingress move), at that moment, ae a sentence at the end of the battle round (Pledges to the Dark Prince), a its own trigger a unit activation (actOf), pk where the ability it selects is in force (pickCover), u where its effect is used (table 1's used-in), limited to the trigger's phases and turn when the text names them and states no duration (no until, this turn, next, for the rest of); none: positively no phase; x: not derivable; per option (optionsOf) s, a (its own WHEN line a unit activation), its own trigger only when it names one, where it is used, x when it has neither and no trigger of its rule; g: an ability it gives units by keyword; f: what it puts in force (inForce); the same words on several units must give one entry, else x

the duration a rule's or ability's own words give its options (oc): coverOf on the first duration in its own words ("until it enters a different one" / "until changed": the rest of the battle), from where it is triggered (a stored moment when derive cannot place it: Harbingers of Dread), when it has options; none read: null

the end moments an option's words name as when something is checked or done (ends): "at the end of a / the turn" both End of your turn and End of your opponent's turn, "of your turn", "of your opponent's turn", "of the battle round" (durations, "until the end of …", left out); a rule listed only through such options (Code Chivalric's Deeds) is listed once at each

judgement.code: const MORTAL_GUARD = /\b(?:feel no pain|invulnerable save|saving throws?|save)\b[^.]*\bmortal wounds\b/i;

source.implements: a protection against mortal wounds (a Feel No Pain or a save "against … mortal wounds": Enraged Abjuration) is used whenever mortal wounds are suffered: every phase of both turns (u of the entry or option)

the moments the list's listed rules and abilities make a named roll ("at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll": Blessings of Khorne; "At the start of the Fight phase, … make a Blessings of Khorne roll": Adamantine Avalanche), their at and t; a sentence "each time / when you make" is not one

an entry whose words say "Each time you make a X roll" (The Blood God's Favour, Icon of Khorne) and is not listed by its own moment: listed (rolled) at the moments the list makes that roll (ckRollMoments), To do now there; none: as it was
